item.title: Copilot often runs tests but does not realize the command finishes
item.body:
Type: Bug I often see Copilot agent go "lets run the tests" in my Rust project, it runs the correct command but then just keeps waiting after the test run completes. I have to stop it manually and say "continue" to get it to move on (at which point it correctly moves on). Does not always happen when running tests, seems to be random. ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8d1766da-df4d-47fd-8d67-2b1ad3c6e0af) ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e3be1655-a33c-440e-87e4-c7ddb73f94c4) Also repros with other commands. Possible common factor: all the commands complete quite fast (sub-second).
